notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Particles of Reality: Remembrance (the sequel to Obsession) is (tentatively) planned for release around summer 2026 and it will ([b]I promise![/b]) wrap up the overarching plot around Victor and the Ethereal storylines. (Hopefully in a satisfying way, that's the plan!)

A store page on Steam will probably come sometime this summer with a demo.

But we're not done with the "Particles of Reality" universe yet!

After Remembrance releases, we'll have two new big content releases planned!

[i]Note: All images shown below are rough, early stage, rough-draft DESIGN documents made by me. Nothing here is final or official or implemented. Artwork, functionality, features, etc, literally everything is subject to change. These are visual aids only.[/i]

[h1]#1. Obsession Updates & DLC: Yandere Monika [/h1]

Development starts fall 2026 (or after Remembrance releases).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42904884/ecf782e4466d528330c07db9f791378a5c2aa4a3.png[/img]

First, new content for Particles of Reality: Obsession!

This will (very probably) include:

Free updates!
[list]
[*] Some new CGs added to the original game for Julian, Brandon, and Quinn (either for existing content or in new side content). 
[*] New sprites for teenage Sebastian, Alexander, and Isabella! (There's been LOTS of requests for this! It's awkward, I know, I'm sorry!)
[*] (Maybe?) Sprites for Antonio and Mr. Dallarosa.
[*] (Probably!) Some new side stories or What If scenarios.
[/list]
A new DLC with new content & CGs: Yandere Monika
[list]
[*] Have you been craving revenge against a certain someone for all the trouble they put you through? Do you wish Obsession-Monika was more forward, brave, and outspoken about her feelings? Do you want another chance at a happy ending? Now's your chance!
[*] This is a "[b]WHAT-IF[/b]" style DLC. It does NOT take place within the overarching plot of the Particles universe. This means a 'happy ending' maybe,[i] just maybe[/i], might be possible. :D
[*] Other details like content quantity/endings, price, and release estimate TBD.
[/list]
[h1]#2: Particles of Reality: Your Life[/h1]

Development starts after Yandere Monika is released. However, there will probably be a (very) short teaser demo much sooner for Patreon members (which I will start working on once the sprite artwork is complete).

This is a new, [b]standalone[/b] game that focuses on Sebastian and his dearest soulmate as they search for a happily ever after.

This game focuses exclusively on Monika and Sebastian. The other LI boys you know and love will be background and side characters in this game.

In these next paragraphs, I'm being intentionally vague for reasons that if I explained could be spoilery:
[list]
[*] Like a "What If", this is outside of the Ethereal plotline.
[*] While Sebastian is still the yandere-mess we know and love, this is planned to be a more traditional visual novel... but it's also still a Particles game, too.
[*] Therefore, happy endings will exist. But they may or may not be of questionable taste. :D
[/list]
The current design plan is as follows:

This game is best described as "Your Boyfriend", "Our Life", "You" (the book/early show seasons), and "Particles of Reality: Obsession" had... 'a relationship' and produced a monstrous baby.

You will play primarily as Monika, but there will be occasional point of view switches where you will also play as Sebastian, who will primarily speak in the "You" style in his obsessive monologue rants.

The game will present in four stages as shown below. (You will be forced to play in order at least through the first pass.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42904884/b6b33b90064500041858359499f0ae98d4cb91b1.png[/img]

In the first two stages (childhood & preteen), the game will play as a stat modifier visual novel, where the story is linear and dialog driven. Your choices will heavily modify Sebastian's stats.

[i]Stats shown are early stage planning and subject to change![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42904884/a7d5f86996944feb6306a7fca216288efa92b6ec.png[/img]

When you reach the second two stages (teenage and adulthood), the game will switch to a more typical Particles style, where you will have some branching choices that will lead to different ends.

However, the choices you're presented and/or the direction of the story after your choices will be influenced heavily by Sebastian's stats.

For a few small examples:

If Sebastian has high strength and charisma, but low confidence and sanity, the risk of him being a serial killer who murders anyone you show interest in skyrockets.

If Sebastian has low strength and charisma, high confidence, but low sanity, he is likely to put Monika on a godlike pedestal and isolate her from everyone as much as possible.

Again, everything you've seen here is in very early design stages, subject to change, and development doesn't start for any of this until next year. Remembrance is the top priority until it is completed! (Alex & Brandon's main routes are done and Sebastian's route starts this weekend for Clairvoyant+ members!)

However, I am always thinking ahead. :D I can't help it... my brain is impatient.

Sprite work for the teenage triplets has been sent out to the artist and will be in the works this year. I'll share those images and more on Patreon & [url=https://discord.gg/EZkjM8cftg]Discord[/url] as details develop!

notes.title: Bug & Achievement Fixes
notes.content:
A few bugfix builds have gone recently out but the big one is a fix for a long-standing bug regarding the final game achievement! A big thank you to those players who helped me identify and resolve these issues via email and Discord.

Note, to get the final achievement [b]ALL[/b] of the following criteria must be met. If any of these are missing, the achievement will not unlock until they are done.

[list]
[*] All particles chapters (1-5) are read
[*] All ends for Seb, Julian, Quinn, Victor are marked complete with a green check
[*] All CGs for Seb, Julian, Quinn, Victor are unlocked and visible in the gallery
[*] All What Ifs for Seb, Julian, and Quinn are marked complete with a green check
[/list]

If you're missing the [b]"Obsession - Completed"[/b] achievement after completing the game, please follow these steps.

[olist]
[*] Shut down Steam completely from your system. This is necessary because a Steam configuration setting for the game has changed on the back-end and this is the only way to force it to update.
[*] Restart Steam.
[*] Update the game to the latest build (if you haven't already)
[*] Start the game
[*] Go to "Settings"
[*] Click the "Achievement Update" button
[/olist]

Other bugs addressed since 1.1.5 announcement:
[list]
[*] Achievement checker updates
[*] Various typos across all routes and some GUI screens. (Thank you Dasha & Discord members!)
[*] Volume of The Jazz Man, Jewel Thieves, and Sodium Vapor tracks reduced
[*] Soul Groove Vapor volume increased slightly
[*] Fixed a config issue for Julian's CG achievement
[*] Fixed Sebastian's end 8 name on the walkthrough.
[*] Fixed some AO notifications missing
[*] Quinn's mother has been renamed to 'Naomi' so we don't have two 'Gabriella' characters.
[*] Unlock requirements updated to fix some false negatives.
[*] Fixed Brandon's walkthrough image End #1 and #2 were switched
[*] Quinn's interview is now properly marked as complete
[/list]

notes.title: New achievement & security changes
notes.content:
Version 1.0.0.5 is now live.

A new achievement has been added to the game to complete everything! All CGs & Endings, including 'What If' endings.

It's been so cool to see the global stats growing as more players have been progressing and I'm so curious how many people have done it all!

If you're still working on finishing the content, no actions required. :D

If you're someone who has already done that - YAY - there's two quick ways to get it unlocked.

You can replay... pretty much any ending in the game OR you can use the handy "Achievement Update" button on the settings screen. That's all!

In addition, there have been some necessary backend security changes made to the game. This should not be noticeable by any players.

But if it unexpectedly causes some issue, my first recommendation would be to use the 'Verify integrity of game files' button in the properties of the game. (Right-click on the game name on your side menu in Steam.)

Thanks and happy playing!

notes.title: New update, possible save file issue!
notes.content:
An update was just pushed that has the potential to break some save files, depending on where specifically you saved. I’m hoping this impacts a very small number of users, if any at all.

Note that this does NOT lose any unlock progress in game. This only may lose your current place mid-route.

I apologize for this, but the way updates are handled on Steam is different than I expected, so I had to restructure some of the backend files to make updates easier and smaller in the future.

[url=https://arewar.itch.io/particles-of-reality/devlog/610710/important-next-update-may-break-some-save-files]This is what the error will look like if you encounter it.[/url]

There are two very easy ways to get back to where you left off if your save file breaks.

[olist]
[*] If you start a route and hit the Tab key, the game will fast-forward through content you already read.
[*] If you right-click ‘Skip’, you can skip all content until the next choice prompts.
[/olist]

These two methods will get you back to where you left off in seconds! And again, no unlock progress or endings completed or anything like that will be lost.

Again, deeply sorry for this, and I hope this is the last time this ever happens. This is my first game developed and I’m a team of one, so I learn some lessons the hard way!

Going forward, updates on Steam will be generally be very small in file-size.

This update also includes a lot of typo fixes in Sebastian’s route.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.0.0-B2D
notes.content:
It's been awhile since there's been a demo update! 

[b]There's two major changes of note in this new demo build:[/b]

1. Julian's route has undergone some revisions. 

While the path and ending are the same in the demo build, there have been some significant changes to Julian's character and new scenes! A brand new character is introduced during his route.

2. Mini-stories have been added to the game, and have been made available in the demo!

There are currently two mini-stories - one in Julian's route, and one in Sebastian's route.

Mini-stories are [b]text-only canon content[/b]. They are similiar to side stories, but shorter in length and without the backgrounds and graphics. These will generally take 5-10 minutes to play.

They exist to provide some valuable insight into the character's background and development, that would otherwise be difficult to do without new art development.

Mini-stories have been included in the demo in hopes to get some feedback from the players!

So please, I'd love to hear your opinions. You can post your feedback on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2128070/discussions/0/5562542086340911022/]PoR Fourm[/url], where I've started a discussion. Or on our [url=http://discord.gg/EZkjM8cftg]Discord[/url].

[b]Other Info:[/b]

The game has a Q2 2023 release date. :)

It is still under development! There's still lots of polish to do in the remaining routes, and more content coming before release.

[b]Character Profiles[/b]

Some images have been floating around for awhile as part of the game advertising! They talk about the character's favorites and... personal interests. [url=https://arewar.itch.io/particles-of-reality/devlog/475942/character-profiles]Check 'em out here![/url]

notes.title: Particles of Reality Demo now live!
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for your interest in Particles of Reality! I'm so excited the game has so much attention, it's far beyond what I've expected!

I've just released the official demo for the game on steam, and you can download it now on the store page!

Please note, this game is still in development! You may find some placeholder art or other minor issues while playing.

Feel free to report these [url=discord.gg/EZkjM8cftg]in Discord[/url] or on the bug sub-fourm [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2128070/discussions/]in Steam's discussion board[/url]. You can also find FAQs in both as well, plus lore and character sheets on Discord.

And as a final reminder - This is an [b]ADULT game[/b] and there are various [b]triggering topics[/b] throughout the stories. Please review the trigger warnings per route before playing! (And if I missed any warnings, please let me know so I can correct it!)

If you find the demo distasteful, the content in the full game will only be worse, so please use the demo to determine if this game is right for you.

I hope you enjoy!
